newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-METALURGS WANTS TO BE ON OFFICIAL LIST-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-METALURGS WANTS TO BE ON OFFICIAL LIST-REPORT.

text.p: Liepajas Metalurgs was surprised at being put on the free list of the bourse and thinks it should be in the official list, the company was quoted by newspaper Dienas Bizness as saying on Friday.
"Such a company as Liepajas should be on the official list," chairman Kirov Lipman told the newspaper.
"We do not want to be on another list so it was a surprise for us when the bourse decided to quote us on the free list," he added.
The free list is for companies which do not meet the stricter conditions of the official and some newspapers have linked the bourse decision with a reluctance by the company to publish its results.
"We do not have anything to hide," he said, noting a recent shareholder meeting which fully discussed its financial results.
Bourse chairman Uldis Cerps however was quoted by the newspaper as saying that the company itself had not fulfilled its promise to inform the bourse about which list it wanted to be on.
He also said that Metalurg's place was on the official list.
